description: The ix modeling platform, ixmp, is IIASA's data warehouse for numerical scenario analysis. It stores versioned scenario inputs and results and connects the database to mathematical models through Python, R and GAMS interfaces. A modeller supplies sets, parameters and model definitions; the platform returns managed scenarios that can be solved, compared and reported. It has no fixed geographic area or time step because those belong to each scenario. The Apache-2.0 source is free on GitHub, and the maintainers publish installation steps, API documentation and transport-problem tutorials. A working study still needs its own input data and, for mathematical optimisation, a compatible solver. The repository distinguishes ixmp from MESSAGEix, the energy model built on top of it. Ixmp can organise assumptions and results for energy capacity-planning simulations and related cross-sector analyses. It does not supply a ready national energy scenario or establish the quality of one. The catalogue already contains model-messageix-framework, while this record covers its underlying scenario-management platform. Documentation was read, but no database or model was run.
